title: Roll out the masking release to qa and prod and confirm masked output
description: After CISO approval of the initiative, build the image from the merged commit and deploy in releaseProcess.environmentsOrder dev -> qa -> prod (EKS ap-south-1), with one approval per releaseProcess.approvalsRequired. mcp-gateway supports the order-routing critical function (30-minute outage tolerance), so deploy prod outside NSE/BSE market hours (09:15-15:30 IST) with the rollback plan ready: revert the PR and redeploy the previous image tag. In qa, call find, aggregate and export on one classified collection from a test MCP client and keep the redacted responses (values masked, no clear-text PII) as evidence. Then update applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server.json pinnedCommit through the normal refresh-ctx process.
acceptanceCriteria: The qa and prod deployments run the image built from the merged masking commit (the deployment image tag or digest matches the release build)

In qa, find, aggregate and export responses for a classified collection show masked values for every redact field in maskingPolicy.json, with screenshots or response captures (PII removed) attached to the task evidence
The prod deployment finished outside 09:15-15:30 IST with no order-routing outage above 30 minutes, as shown in the deployment log

verificationMethod.description: From a test MCP client connected to qa, and then prod read-only, run find (limit 5), aggregate ([{$limit:5}]) and export on one classified collection. Expected result: every field marked redact in maskingPolicy.json comes back masked, partial fields show only the allowed suffix, and export returns a resource_link with no local path.

rootCause.description: The running qa and prod gateways serve the unmasked build, so the code fix closes the gap only once it is deployed and checked in those environments.
